title: C¹ cut-off: a globally C¹, Lipschitz map agreeing with f to first order on K
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, O ⊆ ℝ^P open, K ⊆ ℝ^P compact with K ⊆ O, and f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P of class C¹ on O (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O). Then there are φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P of class C¹ on all of ℝ^P (ContDiff ℝ 1 φ) and Λ ∈ ℝ≥0 such that φ is Λ-Lipschitz and, for every x ∈ K, φ(x) = f(x) and Dφ(x) = Df(x) (D = fderiv ℝ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (O K : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → ∃ (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : NNReal), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ ∧ LipschitzWith Λ φ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, φ x = f x ∧ fderiv ℝ φ x = fderiv ℝ f x
